method: Read public API reference and FAQ JavaScript; primary-domain searches for historical usage/billing endpoints. No login/account/private endpoint request.
finding: Documented per-request response usage and account-wide balance; FAQ supports dashboard per-key filter and report export. No supported automatic per-key historical cost endpoint or schema was verified. This is a documentation gap, not proof that a private/partner API cannot exist.
requiredDependency: Provider-supported read-only historical usage/cost API or contracted automatic report feed
Documented authentication/scopes and nonsecret key identity mapping
Interval timezone, units, cache buckets, model/version, currency/tax and cost semantics
Pagination/cursors, finality/late adjustments, retention and rate limits
Provider-approved access and explicitly authorized test fixtures/account reads
